opportunities.title: Regular Grants

amount.raw: Grants under £100,000. Operating/core cost grants unlikely to exceed 10% of an organisation's total annual budget; project grants tend to be 10-20% of total project cost; capital grants normally no more than 10% of total capital project cost, and for local community projects (e.g. village halls, community centres, places of worship) no greater than £30,000 regardless of project size.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidelines. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited or examined, or Charity Commission annual return). Only one application at a time per organisation; must wait a year after a previous decision before reapplying. Work must take place in the UK or UK Overseas Territories.
opportunities.summary: Rolling funding for UK charities covering operating/core costs, specific projects/activities, and capital projects (building works, repairs, or necessary equipment). Applications are reviewed in the order received, with decisions typically within 4-6 months.

opportunities.title: Major Grants

amount.raw: £100,000 and over. The total cost of what you are applying for must be at least £1 million.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations. For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the total project cost must be at least £1 million (organisation income need not exceed £1 million). Local community capital projects (e.g. church or village hall) should apply for a regular grant instead, typically up to £30,000.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 or more for large-scale capital, project, or core cost requests. Applicants must first complete an Expression of Interest form via the Grants Management Portal, after which the Foundation provides bespoke guidance within 10 working days and may arrange a call.
